# Template — Stakeholder Meeting Request
**Carpenters for Housing Reform Victoria**
Use: Adapt this template for each meeting request. Replace [PLACEHOLDERS] before sending.

**Note:** Replace all [PLACEHOLDERS] before sending. Do not send the template as-is.

## Subject line template
Meeting request — Residential renovation capability pilot briefing — [ORGANISATION]

## Body of email

Dear [RECIPIENT NAME],

I am writing on [DATE] to request a short meeting with you in your capacity as [ROLE] at [ORGANISATION]. Carpenters for Housing Reform Victoria is developing an evidence-led proposal concerning residential renovation capability in Victoria and would value your perspective.

The current work is a bounded, pilot-based proposal intended to test whether a clearer capability framework could improve consumer protection, professional boundaries, and practical decision-making in complex residential renovation work. It is not presented as a predetermined regulatory outcome, and it does not claim or imply government endorsement.

We are seeking a 30-minute briefing to outline the problem being examined, explain the proposed pilot scope, and hear any initial views you may wish to share. If suitable, we would welcome a meeting at [PROPOSED MEETING DATE/TIME], or at another time convenient to you.

If a meeting is possible, I would be pleased to send through any additional background material in advance. Thank you for considering this request.

## What to attach

- Current briefing note or summary paper
- Pilot concept note
- Any relevant consultation or evidence summary

## Closing and signature block

Kind regards,  
[YOUR NAME]
